working_definition: Author type 'C2' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).
searches_performed: 'immature centrifugal neuron C2' (new term, FBbt fbbt/releases/2026-11-02)

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult centrifugal neuron C2 (Özel et al., 2021).

justification: 'C2' is FBbt:00003743 'centrifugal neuron C2'; at P15-P40 the cells are developing (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage), so its immature form FBbt:00053667 (FBbt #2219, release 2026-11-02).

other_candidates.fbbt_term: immature optic lobe centrifugal columnar neuron
other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of a centrifugal columnar neuron (Konstantinides et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent of the new immature C2 term (used until FBbt #2219 was released).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Adult centrifugal neuron with arborizations in the medulla layers M1, M5/M6, M8 and M10 and more restricted arborizations in the lamina (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Kind et al., 2021). In the medulla, it makes reciprocal connections to lamina monopolar neuron L1, and is presynaptic to L2 and L5, as well as medullary intrinsic neuron Mi1 (Takemura et al., 2013). It is GABAergic (Fei et al., 2010). There is usually one of these cells per optic column (Nern et al., 2025).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form, used from the pharate adult stage; no immature form in FBbt.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053667 'immature centrifugal neuron C2' (exact match).
